title: World of Hyatt program: elite tiers and Milestone Rewards

after.name: World of Hyatt Elite Status & Milestone Rewards
after.notes: Benefits of the World of Hyatt program itself, by tier and by Milestone Reward. Benefits of the World of Hyatt Credit Card stay on the card. Milestone Reward rows are updated by a refresh when Hyatt changes its chart; a new chart starts January 1, 2027. A milestone level is awarded once per calendar year. Under the terms effective October 15, 2026, Guest of Honor, Club Access, Suite Upgrade, Category 1-4, Category 1-7, Miraval Extra Night and Ultimate Free Night Awards can each be transferred once to another member, and a member can receive at most 10 transferred awards per calendar year.

changes.summary: Adds the World of Hyatt loyalty program (elite tiers and Milestone Rewards) to your Programs list. The World of Hyatt Credit Card benefits you already track stay on the card and are not repeated.

after.title: Member Benefits (free to join)
after.description: Earn 5 Base Points per eligible US$1 at most Hyatt hotels and resorts (2.5 at Hyatt Studios), book member rates, and redeem points for free nights starting at 3,000 points, subject to availability. Resort, destination or facility fees are waived on Free Night Award nights at participating properties, except where a property's supplemental terms say otherwise; separate service fees are not waived.
after.expiration_note: No expiry. All points are forfeited if the account has no activity for 24 consecutive months.

changes.summary: Baseline benefits every World of Hyatt member gets, before any elite tier.

after.title: Discoverist Benefits (10 nights or 25,000 Base Points)
after.description: 10% bonus on Base Points; preferred room within the room type booked, as available at check-in; premium in-room internet where offered; one bottle of water a day; elite check-in area; 2:00 p.m. late checkout on request (subject to availability at resorts, casino hotels and Destination by Hyatt Residences; not offered at Hyatt Vacation Club); and a dedicated reservation phone line. In-hotel benefits apply on eligible rates and award nights and vary by property.
after.expiration_note: Status earned in a calendar year lasts through the end of February of the second calendar year after qualification (for example, earned in 2026, valid through February 29, 2028).
after.notes: The World of Hyatt Credit Card already gives Discoverist status (tracked on the card). This row lists what the tier includes.

changes.summary: First elite tier, earned with 10 qualifying nights or 25,000 Base Points in a calendar year.

after.title: Explorist Benefits (30 nights or 50,000 Base Points)
after.description: 20% bonus on Base Points. Best room available at check-in, excluding suites and rooms with Club lounge access, at participating properties; brand and property exclusions apply. Room guarantee: one standard guest room at the Standard Rate for personal use if the hotel is otherwise entirely sold out, including suites. Book directly and guarantee the reservation with a valid credit card at least 72 hours before local arrival. Blackouts and hotel requirements apply. Excludes Hyatt resorts, casino hotels, Destination by Hyatt Residences locations, and Residences at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley. Cancellation: cancel up to 24 hours before scheduled check-in if the property's standard cancellation period is 48 hours or less. Excludes Hyatt Vacation Club, Miraval, prepaid or nonrefundable rates, negotiated corporate or group contract rates, and room-specific cancellation policies. Also: early access to award nights; a dedicated Explorist reservation line; plus the Discoverist 2:00 p.m. late checkout, elite check-in, premium internet and bottled water.
after.expiration_note: Status earned in a calendar year lasts through the end of February of the second calendar year after qualification (for example, earned in 2026, valid through February 29, 2028).

changes.summary: Middle elite tier, earned with 30 qualifying nights or 50,000 Base Points in a calendar year.

after.title: Globalist Benefits (60 nights or 100,000 Base Points)
after.description: 30% bonus on Base Points. Best room available at check-in, including standard suites and rooms with Club lounge access, at participating properties; brand and property exclusions apply. 4:00 p.m. late checkout on request (subject to availability at resorts, casino hotels and Destination by Hyatt Residences; not offered at Hyatt Vacation Club). Room guarantee: one standard guest room at the Standard Rate for personal use if the hotel is otherwise entirely sold out, including suites. Book directly and guarantee the reservation with a valid credit card at least 48 hours before local arrival. Blackouts and hotel requirements apply. Excludes Hyatt resorts, casino hotels, Destination by Hyatt Residences resorts, and Residences at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley. Also: priority access to the first available room of the booked category, from 9:00 a.m.; at Hyatt Studios, a choice at check-in of a US$15 market credit or 500 Bonus Points, once per stay; early access to award nights; a dedicated Globalist reservation line; plus elite check-in, premium internet, bottled water and the same 24-hour cancellation rule, with the same exclusions, as Explorist. Club access or breakfast, waived resort fees and parking on free nights are listed as separate rows.
after.expiration_note: Status earned in a calendar year lasts through the end of February of the second calendar year after qualification (for example, earned in 2026, valid through February 29, 2028).
after.notes: Guest of Honor and My Hyatt Concierge are not included with the tier itself; they come from Milestone Rewards.

changes.summary: Top elite tier, earned with 60 qualifying nights or 100,000 Base Points in a calendar year.

after.title: Globalist - Club Lounge Access or Daily Breakfast
after.description: At participating hotels with a Club lounge, Globalists get Club lounge access. Where there is no lounge, or it is closed, Globalists get a daily full breakfast (one entree or the standard buffet, juice and coffee, with tax, gratuity and service charge) for each registered guest in the room, up to 2 adults and 2 children. Not valid for in-room dining and not provided on the day of check-in. Some brands and properties differ or are excluded.
after.expiration_note: Applies on eligible paid and award nights while Globalist status is held.

changes.summary: Globalist lounge and breakfast benefit.

after.title: Globalist - Resort Fees Waived on Paid Stays
after.description: Resort, destination or facility fees are waived for Globalists paying an eligible rate. Separate service fees are not waived. Not valid at Hyatt Vacation Club or at properties excluded in their supplemental terms.
after.expiration_note: Applies on eligible paid stays while Globalist status is held.

changes.summary: Globalist-only waiver of resort fees on paid stays.

after.title: Globalist - Free Parking on Free Night Awards
after.description: Globalists get free parking, valet or self-parking where offered, on nights stayed on a Free Night Award, where the parking charge can be billed to the room. Does not apply to paid nights. Not valid at Hyatt Vacation Club.
after.expiration_note: Being phased out. Members who are Globalist on December 31, 2026 keep it for Free Night Award stays that check out by their tier expiration date or February 29, 2028, whichever comes first. From 2027 Hyatt offers a Free Parking Award as a Milestone Reward choice instead.

changes.summary: Globalist parking on award nights. Hyatt announced on November 18, 2026 that it is being phased out; the dates are in the expiration note.

after.title: Lifetime Globalist Status (1,000,000 lifetime Base Points)
after.description: Globalist status for life after earning 1,000,000 Base Points over the membership. Eligible Hyatt Gold Passport Lifetime Diamond members also received Lifetime Globalist at the program launch on March 1, 2017. Includes all Globalist benefits and access to a dedicated My Hyatt Concierge agent. Each year Lifetime Globalists also receive 4 Suite Upgrade Awards, 5 Guest of Honor Awards and 1 Category 1-7 Free Night Award, issued on or around March 1 (in the year Lifetime status is first reached, at the time it is reached).
after.expiration_note: No requalification; lasts for life or until the program or the membership ends. Annual awards: Suite Upgrade Awards are valid through the end of the year earned plus 14 months; Lifetime Guest of Honor Awards are valid 12 months from issuance; the Category 1-7 Free Night Award is valid 180 days from issuance. Stays using the annual awards must check out by the award expiration date.
after.notes: If you hold Lifetime Globalist, add the yearly awards as your own benefits to count their use; they are described here so they do not clutter the list for everyone else.

changes.summary: Lifetime version of Globalist, with the awards it adds each year.

after.title: Brand Explorer Free Night Award (every 5 brands)
after.description: Earn one Category 1-4 standard-room Free Night Award after completed stays of at least one night, on an eligible rate or a Free Night Award, at 5 different Hyatt brands, and another for each further 5 brands not counted before, over the life of the membership. There is no yearly reset.
after.expiration_note: Each award is valid 1 year from issuance; the stay must check out by the expiry date. No blackout dates, but a hotel's minimum-stay requirement can prevent its use.

changes.summary: Program-wide free night not tied to tier, earned by staying at new Hyatt brands.

after.title: Resort Fees Waived on Free Night Awards (all members)
after.description: Resort, destination or facility fees are waived for every member on nights booked with a Free Night Award at participating properties, except where a property's supplemental terms say otherwise. Separate service fees are not waived. Does not apply to Points + Cash or room upgrade awards.
after.expiration_note: Applies on Free Night Award nights; no cap.

changes.summary: Program-wide fee waiver on award nights, at every tier.

after.title: Early Access to Award Nights (Explorist and above)
after.description: For Free Night Award or Points + Cash reservations made on or after June 30, 2026, Explorists, Globalists, Lifetime Globalists and primary cardholders of a Hyatt credit card (at any tier) get advance access to booking compared with other members.
after.expiration_note: Based on status, or card membership, at the time of booking.
after.notes: Hyatt's terms do not state how much earlier.

changes.summary: Benefit in effect since June 30, 2026: higher tiers and Hyatt cardholders can book award nights earlier.

after.title: Delta SkyMiles Dual Earn (Discoverist and above)
after.description: With linked World of Hyatt and Delta SkyMiles accounts, Discoverists earn 1 World of Hyatt Bonus Point per US$2, and Explorists, Globalists and Lifetime Globalists 1 per US$1, of eligible spend on qualifying premium cabin Delta flights (Delta Comfort, Premium Select, First Class and Delta One), in addition to Delta miles. Taxes and fees are excluded.
after.expiration_note: Ongoing while the accounts are linked and elite status is held.
after.notes: Requires linking the two accounts.

changes.summary: Airline partner benefit launched November 17, 2026.

sources.label: World of Hyatt and Delta SkyMiles

after.title: Aeroplan - Air Canada Flight Credit (Discoverist and above)
after.description: Discoverists, Explorists, Globalists and Lifetime Globalists receive one Air Canada flight credit per calendar year while eligible and linked, including if they first attain status after linking. The credit discounts a new eligible direct Air Canada booking by CA$20 per passenger round-trip or CA$10 per passenger one-way.
after.expiration_note: Use the credit to book within 12 months of deposit to your Aeroplan account. In later years, Air Canada says it deposits the annual credit by April 5 if you remain eligible.
after.notes: Apply at booking. One credit per booking; not valid on multi-city bookings or Aeroplan flight rewards. The credit is in Canadian dollars, so no US dollar value is set.

changes.summary: Partner benefit announced July 15, 2026 for elite members who link their Aeroplan account.

sources.label: Air Canada: Aeroplan and World of Hyatt terms

after.title: Peloton - 100 Bonus Points per Workout (up to 10 a month)
after.description: Members with linked World of Hyatt and Peloton accounts earn 100 Bonus Points for each qualifying workout of at least 10 minutes on a Peloton Bike, Bike+ or Row in the fitness center of a participating Hyatt property during a stay.
after.expiration_note: Normally limited to 1 qualifying workout per day and 10 per calendar month, unless Hyatt permits otherwise in a promotion. Allow up to 3 weeks for points to post.

changes.summary: Partner benefit open to all members who link a Peloton account.

after.title: 20 Qualifying Nights - Milestone Reward unlocked (or 35,000 Base Points)
after.description: Reaching 20 qualifying nights or 35,000 Base Points in a calendar year earns this Milestone Reward. You choose one of: 2 Club Access Awards, a 2K Next Stay Award, a $25 FIND Experience Credit, or 2 American Airlines Preferred Seat coupons. The American Airlines option is offered only to members who linked their World of Hyatt and AAdvantage accounts by November 15, 2026, and only for milestones earned in 2026. Log this milestone once you reach it, then tick the option you chose.
after.expiration_note: Choose within 90 days after Hyatt sends the milestone notification email, or the choice is forfeited.
after.notes: Milestone gate. Log usage on this row once you reach the level; the rows under it then appear. Reaching both the night and the Base Point threshold does not give a second reward.

It confirms a standard suite at booking for one stay of up to 7 consecutive nights, on eligible paid nights, a standard-room or Club free night booked with points, or standard-room Points + Cash. The suite must be available for the whole stay; some properties are excluded. It can be transferred once to another member.
after.expiration_note: Valid through the end of the year earned plus 14 months; the stay must check out by the expiry date. Must be applied when the reservation is made.

changes.summary: One of the options at the 140-night milestone. Tick it if this is the reward you chose.

after.title: 140 Nights Choice - 10,000 Bonus Points
after.description: 10,000 World of Hyatt Bonus Points added to the account.
after.expiration_note: Points are kept as long as the account has activity at least once every 24 months.

changes.summary: One of the options at the 140-night milestone. Tick it if this is the reward you chose.

after.title: 140 Nights Choice - Miraval Extra Night Award
after.description: One complimentary extra consecutive night at a Miraval resort when the member pays an eligible rate, or redeems a Free Night Award or Points + Cash, for a night on the same stay. Standard room, up to double occupancy. The extra night does not come with the nightly resort credit and cannot be combined with a room upgrade award. It can be transferred once to another member.
after.expiration_note: Valid 180 days from issuance; the stay must check out by the expiry date.

changes.summary: One of the options at the 140-night milestone. Tick it if this is the reward you chose.

after.title: 140 Nights Choice - AAdvantage Platinum Status
after.description: AAdvantage Platinum status in the member's own AAdvantage account. No added benefit if the member already holds that status or higher.
after.expiration_note: The status lasts for the AAdvantage membership year tied to the qualification period in which the milestone was reached, not when the reward is selected.
after.notes: Available only for a milestone earned in 2026, with World of Hyatt and AAdvantage accounts linked by 11:59 p.m. Central Time on November 15, 2026. The selection can be made in 2027 if it falls within the 90-day selection window. Not offered for milestones earned in 2027.

changes.summary: One of the options at the 140-night milestone. Tick it if this is the reward you chose.

after.title: 150 Qualifying Nights - Milestone Reward unlocked
after.description: Reaching 150 qualifying nights in a calendar year earns this Milestone Reward. You receive an Ultimate Free Night Award automatically and choose one of: a Suite Upgrade Award, 10,000 Bonus Points, a Miraval Extra Night Award, or AAdvantage Platinum status. The American Airlines option is offered only to members who linked their World of Hyatt and AAdvantage accounts by November 15, 2026, and only for milestones earned in 2026. Log this milestone once you reach it, then tick the option you chose.
after.expiration_note: Choose within 90 days after Hyatt sends the milestone notification email, or the choice is forfeited. The automatic award needs no selection.
after.notes: Milestone gate. Log usage on this row once you reach the level; the rows under it then appear.

changes.summary: Gate row for the 150-night Milestone Reward (2026 chart). The awards under it appear only after you log this level.
